Verify SHA-256 Digests of Local Model Weights

Source: R/container.R
verify_model_digest.Rd

Computes streaming SHA-256 digests of a local model file (e.g., GGUF or safetensors) or a directory of sharded weight files without loading the weights into memory, and optionally compares against a pinned expected digest.

Usage

verify_model_digest(
  path,
  expected_digest = NULL,
  algorithm = "sha256",
  error_on_mismatch = FALSE,
  root_dir = NULL,
  allow_symlinks = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Character scalar path to a local model file or directory of model files.

expected_digest

Optional expected SHA-256 digest string (for a single file or directory manifest) or named character vector mapping relative file paths to SHA-256 digests (for a directory).

algorithm

Hash algorithm; currently "sha256".

error_on_mismatch

Logical scalar; if TRUE and verification fails, aborts with an airgap_digest_error. Defaults to FALSE.

root_dir

Optional directory path that path must remain strictly confined within (blocks symlink escapes and path traversal).

allow_symlinks

Logical scalar; if FALSE (default), rejects any symbolic links encountered at path or inside a model directory.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_digest_verification" containing path, is_directory, algorithm, actual_digest, expected_digest, matched, size_bytes, files (tibble), and verified_at.

Examples

tmp_model <- tempfile(fileext = ".gguf")
writeBin(charToRaw("mock-gguf-weights-v1"), tmp_model)
res <- verify_model_digest(tmp_model)
verify_model_digest(tmp_model, expected_digest = res$actual_digest)
#> <airgap_digest_verification> [MATCHED]
#>   Path:       /tmp/RtmpfjVEMS/file18f96e703eeb.gguf
#>   Size bytes: 20
#>   Actual:     sha256:2a1762b7ed43674195cebce6e770011d1738919f1c866411ab76ab2de9b07aa1
#>   Expected:   sha256:2a1762b7ed43674195cebce6e770011d1738919f1c866411ab76ab2de9b07aa1
unlink(tmp_model)
